title.zh: Moody's Rates Sky B3, Flagging Thin Capital Buffer
title.en: Moody's Rates Sky B3, Flagging Thin Capital Buffer

current_state.zh: Moody's rated Sky B3 with a stable outlook, placing the DeFi protocol behind USDS in speculative-grade territory and flagging its thin equity buffer of roughly $90 million against about $10 billion in managed assets.
current_state.en: Moody's rated Sky B3 with a stable outlook, placing the DeFi protocol behind USDS in speculative-grade territory and flagging its thin equity buffer of roughly $90 million against about $10 billion in managed assets.
